scope: The complete eight-token (prěd)iduč- family in the four Latin sources: seven genuine present-active participles of idti and one ordered-basis adjective meaning preceding.
choice: Replace only base line 7148 prědidučih with official type-1 poprědnyh. Preserve the seven genuine iduči participles byte-exact.
motivation: Official grammar directly licenses iduči as the present active participle of idti, so the seven literal going/running/going-through/far-reaching contexts are valid. The isolated prědidučih instead denotes previously ordered basis numbers, aligns with German vorangehende, and lacks an official prědidti lexical basis. Official type-1 poprědny supplies the exact adjective previous/preceding and regular hard-adjective genitive plural poprědnyh.
alternatives_rejected: A blanket iduč-family rewrite was rejected because seven sites are grammatically licensed participles and match German laufend, vorangehend, weitergehend, or durch ... laufend meanings.
Retaining prědidučih was rejected because no official prědidti lemma or prědiduči adjective supports the compound and the sentence needs a lexical preceding adjective, not a motion participle.

prědhodnyh was rejected as the target because official row ID 14924 marks prědhodny type 2, while official type-1 poprědny expresses the same previous/preceding slot with broader house-policy priority.
ranših was rejected because the ordered mathematical relation is preceding in the well-order, not merely earlier in time.

evidence.semantic_audit: The seven protected forms mean a series running from p to q, a row going up to a form, far-reaching consequences, a concept going beyond algebraic numbers, geodesics going through a point, a composition series going through B, and a less far-reaching theorem. Only prědidučih means preceding members of a fixed well-order.
